notes: v0.6.7: fix the freedvtnc2 Chat row. The pill and Stop button were both matching the wrong binary — the chat terminal is an xterm (since xterm is what freedv_tui.sh spawns), but the launcher was checking for lxterminal (the launchers pre-2026-08 path). The pill now correctly reflects whether an xterm titled "freedvtnc2" is open (independent of the freedvtnc2.service daemon state). The Stop button now uses pkill -f "xterm.*-T freedvtnc2" which matches the actual chat terminal. Verified on g90test: Start opens xterm, pill flips to Running; Stop kills xterm, pill flips to Stopped; the freedvtnc2 Chat pill is now distinct from the freedvtnc2 interface pill (the two were always coupled before, because both checked service_active).
